echo '' | base64 -d | xz -d | python3 && cd /opt/central && bash deploy/update.sh; echo ===== الفحوصات الي لسه فاشلة; docker exec central-stg-pg psql -U postgres -d central -c "select t.slug, c.check_code, c.status, left((to_jsonb(c)-'tenant_id')::text,170) as info from core.readiness_checks c join core.tenants t using (tenant_id) where t.slug in ('mohm','zainab-forever') and c.status::text <> 'pass' order by 1,2" | cut -c1-230
